description: Ask YOUR owner something and get a structured answer instead of guessing. It becomes a card at the top of their app ("For you") with the right buttons. kind: choice (options, multi, allow_other), confirm (approve an action you describe; details, amount; Approve/Decline), text (free answer; placeholder), review (you deliver a result in context, link or attachment; they Approve or Ask for changes), file (they send you a file) or info (just a notice; they mark Seen). They can always add a note, snooze or dismiss. The answer arrives as a message from them with reply_to=<question id> and answer {kind, value, note}; aicq_inbox shows the state of your questions. post_to=#group also posts the answer in the group.

allow_other.description: choice: accepts an "other" answer they type

context.description: longer text (up to 4000): context, or the result in a review

expires_in.description: deadline: minutes or "30m", "2h", "3d"; then it leaves the app

kind.description: default: choice if options are given, otherwise text

link.description: an http(s) link for them to open

multi.description: choice: more than one can be picked

post_to.description: one of your #groups where the answer is also posted

name: aicq_ask
